blocks.text: COTABATO CITY —- The new head of the education ministry in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) has sought a fresh probe into allegations teaching positions are being sold, an old issue that kept hounding the agency until today. Member of the Parliament and education minister Naguib Sinarimbo said that recent complaints pointed to scholarship slots also becoming the subject of the unscrupulous scheme within the Ministry of Basic, Higher and Technical Education (MBHTE), the largest agency within the BARMM bureaucracy, with a budget of P26.49 billion in 2026. “I have received numerous alarming reports, both on social media […]...
